display.purpose: The revealed round average — the single expressive typographic moment per screen.

kicker.purpose: Eyebrow label above a value or heading; always via the Kicker component.

shadows.name: island
shadows.purpose: The only shadow role in the system — reserved for the two floating island controls (RoomControlIsland, ParticipantBar).

motion.name: island-spring
motion.purpose: Every join/leave/expand/collapse on a floating island control — one spring signature app-wide, defined in shared/lib/motion.ts as ISLAND_SPRING.

motion.name: rise-in

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The app's one button primitive, primary variant.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(0.9); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline variant of the same button primitive.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.55); }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Compact status/value chip (a cast vote, a checkmark).
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #2563eb; background: #ffffff; color: #475569; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Kicker
components.description: The one eyebrow-label component in the system.
components.css: .ds-kicker { color: #2563eb; font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Playing Card
components.description: The signature physical-object card: corner pips, center circle badge, printed watermark texture.
components.html: 888
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; width: 160px; height: 224px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; background: #f5f7fd; color: #0f172a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-card-corner { position: absolute; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-corner-tl { top: 8px; left: 8px; } .ds-card-corner-br { bottom: 8px; right: 8px; transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-card-corner-value { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-corner-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #2563eb; } .ds-card-badge { width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #2563eb; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Island Trigger
components.description: The top floating glass control (RoomControlIsland) — frosted, elevated, opens the room-management modal.
components.css: .ds-island-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15); background: rgba(250, 251, 255, 0.85); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); padding: 10px 16px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-island-trigger:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-island-trigger:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-island-text { flex: 1; } .ds-island-code { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #0f172a; } .ds-island-chevron { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; color: #475569; }

narrative.overview: BigPoker replaces a physical Planning Poker deck with a screen everyone in the same room glances at together. The system reads as a table lit from underneath: soft, blurred aurora light (blue and violet radial gradients) washes the whole page, and on top of it sit two kinds of objects. The first is paper — the playing cards, form fields, and buttons are opaque, flat, almost printed, because they're standing in for physical objects a hand would pick up. The second is glass — the two floating island controls (the room-code trigger at the top, the participant bar at the bottom) are true frosted glass: translucent, blurred, floating above the content in a fixed position, borrowing Apple's Dynamic Island language. Nothing else in the system gets that glass treatment; it's reserved for controls that float independent of the document's scroll.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, opaque "paper" for anything a user directly manipulates (cards, buttons, fields).
Translucent "glass" strictly for the two floating island overlays — never blended into content-flow surfaces.
One accent color (blue) carries every interactive/semantic signal; violet is atmosphere only.
One expressive font (Sora) reserved for exactly one moment: the revealed number.
Physical-card literalism: the playing card face deliberately mimics a real Planning Poker card.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only color that means "interactive" or "current." Violet never appears on anything the user can click or that carries state.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Local Rule
rules.body: Every color token in styles.css is solid hex, never rgba(). Translucency for a specific surface is applied with Tailwind's /opacity modifier directly on that component's className, never by editing the shared token.

rules.name: The One Display Moment Rule
rules.body: Sora appears exactly once per screen, on the revealed number, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Island Exception Rule
rules.body: Shadow and backdrop-blur are reserved for the two fixed/floating island controls. A card, button, or field sitting in normal document flow never gets a shadow.

rules.name: The Full-Pill Default Rule
rules.body: Any new interactive control defaults to rounded-full unless it has a documented reason not to.

dos: Do keep every token in styles.css's @theme block solid hex — no rgba()/alpha at the token level.
Do apply translucency locally with Tailwind's /opacity modifier on the specific component that needs glass.
Do reach for @tabler/icons-react for any icon; match the h-4 w-4 sizing already used across the app.

Do route every eyebrow/label through Kicker, never a hand-styled uppercase

.
Do default new interactive controls to rounded-full unless documented otherwise.
Do reuse ISLAND_SPRING for any new floating/overlay motion.
donts: Don't add a shadow or backdrop-blur to a normal-flow surface — elevation is reserved for the two fixed island controls.
Don't introduce a second hue as an interactive/semantic signal — blue is the only accent.
Don't use Sora anywhere but the revealed-average number.
Don't make the playing card's own background translucent — it sits in an overlapping Stack and needs to stay opaque.
